lcc_original: 上帝說：『衆水之間要有穹蒼，將水和水分開。』
notes: 上帝 (LCC) vs 神 (UNV) — both render אֱלֹהִים (H0430); systematic LCC/UNV difference
穹蒼 (LCC) vs 空氣 (UNV) — both render רָקִיעַ (H07549, firmament/expanse); LCC uses more astronomically precise term
LCC's second explicit 水 (in 和水) corresponds to UNV's implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH04325>} (לָמָיִם) — applied Rule 3, dropped braces
LCC 分開 (two-char compound) carries the SN and morphology of UNV 分 (<WH0914><WTH8688>)
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וִיהִי, 'and let it be') remains implicit in LCC — no explicit Chinese word corresponds to it in the 將…分開 structure
